mechanismsOfAction.note: Roughly 20-fold less potent than sertraline at SERT. Contributes little to therapeutic effect.

pharmacokinetics.notes: Two to four times the parent's half-life. Clinically this is a washout fact rather than an efficacy fact: it takes roughly 2-3 weeks after stopping sertraline for this to clear, which is part of why the serotonin-syndrome interactions on the parent record do not end at the last dose.
